name: report

select.description: Which read to run. A field marked [select: ...] applies only to the selects named.

runId.description: Run to roll up. Exactly one of runId and anchorId. [select: rollup]

anchorId.description: Subtree root to roll up. Exactly one of runId and anchorId. [select: rollup]

rootId.description: Only this project root; default every root you may see. [select: usage, gates, contention, waste]

since.description: ISO 8601 instant; default 7 days ago. [select: usage, gates, contention, waste]

until.description: ISO 8601 instant; default now. [select: usage, gates, contention, waste]

groupBy.description: Row grouping; each select accepts a subset (see describe). [select: usage, gates, contention]

limit.description: Page size, 1 to 200 (default 50). [select: usage, gates, contention]

cursor.description: The page.next value of the previous page. [select: usage, gates, contention]

describe.description: true: return the operations, their parameters and errors instead of running the tool.

description: Aggregate reports: a run or subtree rollup, and usage, gate, contention and waste metrics. Call with describe:true for each operation's parameters and errors.
